title: ze_iceskate
description:
ze_ICESKATE
Fresh new map! You liked surf maps? Try an ICESKATE one.
Slide across a big ice arena and keep your speed. The goal is simple: be the fastest!

How to play
Race across the ice and grab items to slow the others down.
Everything is random, every round will be different!
The map also has a rank that updates every round to show the fastest players.

For now the map has 4 endings and 16 items. More modes, endings and items will be added.

MAP NEED CS2FIX OLD PUSHES ENABLED

Map by Raphi and King Buzzo
